actions.name: legendary resistance
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} fails a saving throw, it can choose to succeed instead.

actions.name: magic resistance
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} has Advantage on saving throws against spells and other magical effects.

actions.name: reflective carapace
actions.desc: If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is targeted by a @UUID[Compendium.dnd5e.spells24.Item.phbsplMagicMissi]{Magic Missile} spell or a spell that requires a ranged attack roll, roll [[/r 1d6]]. On a 1–5, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected. On a 6, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} is unaffected and reflects the spell, turning the caster into the target.

actions.name: multiattack
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} makes one [[/item .mmBite0000000000]] attack and three other attacks, using [[/item .mmClaw0000000000]] or [[/item .mmTail0000000000]] in any combination.

actions.name: bite
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]], and the target has the &Reference[Grappled apply=false] condition (escape DC [[lookup @skills.ath.passive]]). Until the grapple ends, the target has the &Reference[Restrained apply=false] condition and can't teleport.

actions.name: tail
actions.desc: [[/attack extended]]. [[/damage average extended]]. If the target is a Huge or smaller creature, it has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition.

actions.name: thunderous bellow
actions.desc: Constitution Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=RWBqtTjGSlEgQWCl]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=RWBqtTjGSlEgQWCl]] in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=RWBqtTjGSlEgQWCl]]-[[lookup @target.template.units activity=RWBqtTjGSlEgQWCl]]. [[lookup @target.template.type capitalize activity=RWBqtTjGSlEgQWCl]]. Failure: [[/damage average]] damage, and the target has the &Reference[Deafened apply=false] and &Reference[Frightened apply=false] conditions until the end of its next turn. Success: Half damage only.

actions.name: swallow
actions.desc: Strength Saving Throw: DC [[lookup @save.dc.value activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]], [[lookup @target.affects.special activity=YorssyWMumAsvzx3]] by the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} (it can have up to six creatures swallowed at a time). Failure: The target is swallowed, and the Grappled condition ends. A swallowed creature has the &Reference[Blinded apply=false] and &Reference[Restrained apply=false] conditions and can't teleport, it has &Reference[Total Cover] against attacks and other effects outside the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}, and takes [[/damage average activity=zrWNjO9mkbN28spL]] damage at the start of each of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster}'s turns. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} takes 60 damage or more on a single turn from a creature inside it, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} must succeed on a [[/save format=long activity=rGeGukkm2t2fXsoy]] at the end of that turn or regurgitate all swallowed creatures, each of which falls in a space within [[lookup @range.value activity=rGeGukkm2t2fXsoy]] feet of the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} and has the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. If the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} dies, any swallowed creature no longer has the Restrained condition and can escape from the corpse by using 20 feet of movement, exiting Prone.

actions.name: onslaught
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to half its Speed, and it makes one [[/item .mmClaw0000000000]] or [[/item .mmTail0000000000]] attack.

actions.name: world-shaking movement
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} moves up to its Speed. At the end of this movement, the [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} creates an instantaneous shock wave in a [[lookup @target.template.size activity=g4W0ovZxBeUrZKb8]]-[[lookup @target.template.units activity=g4W0ovZxBeUrZKb8]]. Emanation originating from itself. Creatures in that area lose &Reference[Concentration] and, if Medium or smaller, have the &Reference[Prone apply=false] condition. The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} can't take this action again until the start of its next turn.

actions.name: siege monster
actions.desc: The [[lookup @name lowercase]]{monster} deals double damage to objects and structures.
